Description: The number of users in the e-commerce market in Romania was modeled to be 6.43 million users in 2024. Following a continuous upward trend, the number of users has risen by 3.75 million users since 2017. Between 2024 and 2029, the number of
users will rise by 2.2 million users, continuing its consistent upward trajectory. Read more
Note(s): Romania; 2017 to 2029
Source(s): Statista; Statista Market Insights
